address: località Borro 52, San Giustino Valdarno, 52024, Italy
bio: In the heart of Valdarno, Osteria del Borro is located within a thousand-hectare estate that houses an authentic medieval village. In the summer, you can dine on a terrace with breathtaking views of the countryside, while in the winter, you can settle into an elegant room with soft tones and an open kitchen. There are three tasting menus, built around local products and, most importantly, the estate's own garden....
